en.title: Tenant launch and growth operations
en.intro: Prepare tenants, review renewals, resolve support requests and route consented enquiries.

en.conflict: This record changed or the workflow is not eligible. Refresh before retrying.

en.renewal_note: Upload a renewal as a new revision. Previous files and decisions remain in the history. Downloads require an authenticated session.

en.consent: Evidence of consent to share contact details with the assigned tenant

Accepted enquiries become growth leads; accepted assignments cannot be reassigned. Existing marketing enquiry forms retain their current routing.

en.service_unavailable: Service not sold in this territory
en.withdraw_note: Withdrawal blocks contact on the delivered growth lead; it does not erase the audit history.

en.consent_confirm: The person requested contact and agreed to share their details with the matching tenant.
en.reply_note: Add a message to this ticket.
en.cannot_upload: Select a supported file of at most 2 MB.

en.attention_search: Search tenant name, code or record ID
en.attention_scope_own: Only your tenant’s records are shown.
en.launch_feedback_note: Address the review feedback and submit again. A new human approval is required.
en.history_note: Pages show current records, newest first. Refresh after new activity; this is not a frozen export.
en.history_preview_note: Previews show up to 20 entries. Open full history for older records.

listNavigation.requirement: Support and territory-routing filters must display the selected workflow and matching API page, reset offset on apply, and preserve unapplied search through language changes. Switching tabs must not restore the previous workflow selector.

launchReview.requirement: Global human reviewers can return submitted administrative launches with required evidence; tenants see the latest return reason, correct prerequisites and resubmit for a new explicit human approval.

historyPolicy.requirement: Administrators can read all tenant document revisions, ticket messages/deadline events and launch decisions through bounded, scoped API pages; initial previews must not grow without limit.
historyPolicy.scope: existing authenticated bundle roles; own-tenant boundaries; ticket must belong to requested tenant
historyPolicy.ordering: latest revisions first for documents; newest timestamp/ID first for messages; highest committed workflow version first for decisions/deadlines
historyPolicy.pagination: live offset pages in a repeatable-read transaction; refresh or mutations reset the viewer; not a frozen export across requests
historyPolicy.storage: metadata only; document bytes use authenticated attachment download

accessibility.requirement: Keyboard history open/page/close must retain meaningful focus; failed reads focus the error status; unrelated drafts persist. Shared shell document language follows EN/FR/ES and bundle navigation restores its initiating control after asynchronous reads.
accessibility.focusVisibility: Focused history/status/navigation targets must remain below the measured sticky top bar; mobile section navigation must preserve content focus when closing the sidebar.
